cancel.expression: (async()=>{const o={};let release,seen;const s=new ReadableStream({cancel(r){seen=r;return new Promise(resolve=>release=resolve)}});const r=s.getReader();const pending=r.read();let readSettled=false;pending.then(()=>readSettled=true);const p=r.cancel('stop');o.synchronous={locked:s.locked,seen,readSettled};await Promise.resolve();o.microtask={locked:s.locked,readSettled};release();await p;o.settled={locked:s.locked,read:await pending};try{o.after=await r.read()}catch(e){o.after={name:e.name,message:e.message}}return JSON.stringify(o)})()

cancelReject.expression: (async()=>{const s=new ReadableStream({cancel(){return Promise.reject(new Error('failed'))}});const r=s.getReader();try{await r.cancel()}catch(e){return JSON.stringify({locked:s.locked,name:e.name,message:e.message})}})()

byob.expression: (async()=>{const o={};for(const type of ['bytes','other']){const s=new ReadableStream({type,start(c){o[type+'Controller']=c.constructor.name;c.enqueue('notbytes');c.close()}});try{const r=s.getReader({mode:'byob'});o[type]={name:r.constructor.name,value:await r.read(new Uint8Array(1))}}catch(e){o[type]={name:e.name,message:e.message}}}return JSON.stringify(o)})()
